scope: Feature-branch evaluation point, not an approved coexistence release default
stageBDiagnostic: Energy is often above reproduction threshold; lineages still fail. Compare reproduction probability 0.018 versus 0.020 only, keeping plant gain 0.5 and the three Stage A preferences.
rationale: No Stage A or B candidate reaches the 10–25/50 full-web fox persistence target; do not claim calibration success.
Keep nominal plant gain 0.5: at maximum efficiency it remains 1.5, below basal cost 1.7. Larger gains lose this analytic buffer-only guarantee.
Among unchanged-gain Stage A candidates, preference 0.67 improves full-web fox persistence from 1 to 2 and wolf persistence from 2 to 10; rabbit extinction falls from 38 to 37.
Rabbit+fox fox persistence rises from 27 to 38 and rabbit extinction falls from 9 to 2.
Reject the secondary reproduction change: it does not improve full-web fox persistence and can increase rabbit extinction.
Freeze this evaluation point before holdout. A failed holdout cannot be used for another tuning iteration.
